'''Kanan's Joben T-85 speeder bike''' was a [[Joben T-85 speeder bike]] owned by the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Kanan Jarrus]]. The bike had a [[Color|green]] and sand coloration.<ref name="Databank" /> It was destroyed by an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[orbital bombardment]] issued by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] during the [[battle of Atollon]]<ref name="Zero Hour" /> in 2 BBY.<ref name="Date" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The design of Kanan's Joben T-85 speeder bike in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' was revealed by [[Dave Filoni]] in [[Celebration Europe (2016)|Celebration Europe]] [[2016]] to have been inspired by a [[Ahsoka Tano's speeder bike|speeder bike]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] was going to use in a planned four-episode story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV series, which went unproduced due the show's cancellation.<ref name="Ahsoka's Untold Tales">{{SWYouTube|lS4sclln5J4|Ahsoka's Untold Tales Panel | Star Wars Celebration Europe 2016}}</ref>
